notes: Site is Docusaurus; component prop tables and code examples are lazily rendered client-side (intersection-observer-driven) — pages were scraped by navigating, then scrolling incrementally through full page height (150-250ms dwell per step) before reading get_page_text, to force lazy content to mount.

javascript_tool's return value gets blocked by a 'Cookie/query string data' safety filter when it echoes raw <pre> code block text (e.g. component example source) back as a tool result — NOT triggered by get_page_text or by returning small JSON summaries (counts, h1 arrays). All page content in this run was captured via get_page_text instead of javascript_tool DOM extraction.

Raw files are hand-condensed (not verbatim get_page_text dumps): headings/description kept, near-duplicate example variations collapsed to 1-2 representative snippets, full API prop tables kept (these are the highest-value content, including Russian descriptions and @deprecated markers).

Every file that documents a component whose name collides with a cs-core/cs-portal export (Badge, Combobox, Popover, Overlay, Modal, Tabs, Table, showToast, Segment/useSegment, Mutation*) is annotated inline with a NOTE pointing to the shadowing relationship — see UI_LIBS_DOCS_PLAN.md section 2.1.

beta/popover and beta/tooltip import from '@salutejs/sdds-cs/beta', a separate entry point NOT covered by cs-portal's `export * from '@salutejs/sdds-cs'` (which only re-exports the main entry). Flagged in both files.

components/toast-legacy vs components/toast vs cs-portal's own showToast (from cs-core) are three different APIs sharing similar names — flagged in components__toast.txt and components__toast-legacy.txt.
form/components.txt, form/native-form.txt, form/react-hook-form.txt cover form-library integration, not a single component.
how-to-icons.txt and utils__mixins.txt are guide pages, not components, per the plan's file-map (feed icons.md and a mixins note respectively).
